correctness.rationale: Uniform identity \(5P_{n+4}=P_n+12P_{n+3}\) and the Pell gcd law yield all pairwise gcds. For \(3\mid n\), reduced-pair gluing proves symmetry. For \(3\nmid n\), \(n\ge5\), an \(a\mid(12-5v)\) obstruction proves three-generator minimality, and every nontrivial pair-gcd gluing is excluded by size or divisibility. Exceptional indices \(n=1,2,4\) are two-generated. A finite exact Apéry census checks the first 12 indices; the proof is unrestricted.

Unlike the already studied Pell family with fixed first gap \(2\), this needs a new all-index arithmetic exclusion; it is not a finite isolated table or simple substitution.
